Your workspace

Choose an activity above. Your work is saved in this browser.

Write a question on the front and a short answer on the back. Say your answer aloud or write it down before you flip.

“Got it” moves to the next card. “Study again” also moves on and flags this card for your next pass.

Use the questions you entered as flashcards. Answer first, reveal the saved answer, then decide whether you got it right.

Compare meaning, not just wording. If unsure, mark it for review.

Study a topic now, then add a date to return to it. After each review, choose the next date that fits your course schedule.
Before you begin: Create flashcards for at least two different topics in the Flashcards activity. Mixed Practice uses those saved questions and answers; there is no separate question entry here.

During practice, decide which idea or method applies before showing the saved answer.

Close your notes. Explain the idea as if you were helping a classmate. Then check your notes and add what you missed.
